bubbles.title: Pre-push hook choice
bubbles.hint: git pre-push hook in versioned .githooks/, enabled per clone via 'git config core.hooksPath .githooks' (Windows + Linux sandbox). Client-side only: GitHub can't enforce time windows.

bubbles.title: Time-window check
bubbles.hint: Check the current time at push only (commit times ignored): blocked when local time is Mon-Fri 08:00-16:59. Window configurable; pure function so it's testable.

bubbles.title: No-verify bypass
bubbles.hint: Escape hatch is 'git push --no-verify'; document it, no custom override.

bubbles.title: Tests
bubbles.hint: Cover boundaries: Fri 16:59 blocked, Fri 17:00 ok, Sat ok, Mon 07:59 ok, Mon 08:00 blocked.
